public_format.structure: At content_check.path, supply {rows:[row], summary:counts, unresolved:[key], period, base_unit}; This result object has exactly these five keys, each row exactly row_fields, and each evidence exactly the eight stated fields; put extra explanation outside this result object. public_format.coverage: One row for every key in the union of both source tables. key contains values of key_fields in their stated order. left_ids/right_ids retain all original record IDs, including ambiguous candidates. Do not drop duplicates, absent sides, conflicts or missing values.
public_format.evidence: For every original candidate, preserve an evidence object with alias, record_id, location, period, definition, currency, unit, value copied from that source. Evidence entries form a multiset: retain repeated candidates.
public_format.classification: More than one candidate on either side is ambiguous; an absent side is missing. public_format.structure: At content_check.path, supply {rows:[row], summary:counts, unresolved:[key], period, base_unit}; This result object has exactly these five keys, each row exactly row_fields, and each evidence exactly the eight stated fields; put extra explanation outside this result object. Source references use each content_check.sources.reference_path and match actual exact-work adoptions.
public_format.coverage: One row for every key in the union of both source tables. key contains values of key_fields in their stated order. left_ids/right_ids retain all original record IDs, including ambiguous candidates. Do not drop duplicates, absent sides, conflicts or missing values.
public_format.evidence: For every original candidate, preserve an evidence object with alias, record_id, location, period, definition, currency, unit, value copied from that source. Evidence entries form a multiset: retain repeated candidates.
public_format.classification: More than one candidate on either side is ambiguous; an absent side is missing. Otherwise periods/definitions/currencies must match, period must be the public reporting_period and both units must occur in unit_factors, or the pair is incomparable. Compatible pairs with null values are missing. Compatible numeric pairs use the public factors and base_unit; unequal normalized values are conflict; equal normalized values are matched for the same original unit, converted for different original units.
public_format.numbers: Only compatible numeric pairs have left_value/right_value/delta (left minus right). All three otherwise remain JSON null. row.period is the shared period only for exactly one candidate per side with equal periods, otherwise null.
public_format.summary: Object with exactly the six status names and their integer row counts, including zero counts. unresolved lists keys whose status is not matched or converted. Top-level period/base_unit are those of the public basis.

public_format.coverage: One row for every key in the union of both source tables. key contains values of key_fields in their stated order. left_ids/right_ids retain all original record IDs, including ambiguous candidates. Do not drop duplicates, absent sides, conflicts or missing values.
public_format.evidence: For every original candidate, preserve an evidence object with alias, record_id, location, period, definition, currency, unit, value copied from that source. Evidence entries form a multiset: retain repeated candidates.
public_format.classification: More than one candidate on either side is ambiguous; an absent side is missing. Otherwise periods/definitions/currencies must match, period must be the public reporting_period and both units must occur in unit_factors, or the pair is incomparable. Compatible pairs with null values are missing. Compatible numeric pairs use the public factors and base_unit; unequal normalized values are conflict; equal normalized values are matched for the same original unit, converted for different original units.
public_format.numbers: Only compatible numeric pairs have left_value/right_value/delta (left minus right). All three otherwise remain JSON null. row.period is the shared period only for exactly one candidate per side with equal periods, otherwise null.
public_format.summary: Object with exactly the six status names and their integer row counts, including zero counts. unresolved lists keys whose status is not matched or converted. Top-level period/base_unit are those of the public basis.

public_format.coverage: One row for every key in the union of both source tables. key contains values of key_fields in their stated order. left_ids/right_ids retain all original record IDs, including ambiguous candidates. Do not drop duplicates, absent sides, conflicts or missing values.
public_format.evidence: For every original candidate, preserve an evidence object with alias, record_id, location, period, definition, currency, unit, value copied from that source. Evidence entries form a multiset: retain repeated candidates.
public_format.classification: More than one candidate on either side is ambiguous; an absent side is missing. Otherwise periods/definitions/currencies must match, period must be the public reporting_period and both units must occur in unit_factors, or the pair is incomparable. Compatible pairs with null values are missing. Compatible numeric pairs use the public factors and base_unit; unequal normalized values are conflict; equal normalized values are matched for the same original unit, converted for different original units.
public_format.numbers: Only compatible numeric pairs have left_value/right_value/delta (left minus right). All three otherwise remain JSON null. row.period is the shared period only for exactly one candidate per side with equal periods, otherwise null.
public_format.summary: Object with exactly the six status names and their integer row counts, including zero counts. unresolved lists keys whose status is not matched or converted. Top-level period/base_unit are those of the public basis.

Compatible numeric pairs use the public factors and base_unit; unequal normalized values are conflict; equal normalized values are matched for the same original unit, converted for different original units.
public_format.numbers: Only compatible numeric pairs have left_value/right_value/delta (left minus right). All three otherwise remain JSON null. row.period is the shared period only for exactly one candidate per side with equal periods, otherwise null.

diagnostic_labels.pilot_source_scope: Clean frozen source identity captured before/after; original outputs are retained

value.identity: SHA256 of local bytes, not validation of HF authenticity

value.sampling: one shared RNG stream; batching/order recorded, not per-episode deterministic
value.policy_probabilities: chosen-token log-probabilities captured from actual temperature-scaled sampling logits; greedy requests keep None

interpretation.A1: All36predeclared episodes are retained, with reward0. Two DeepSeek institutional completed outcomes have content_failure for missing exact contributing-file dependencies. Qwen18 outcomes are model_format_error. Completed is not business correctness; zero reward failures were not filtered out.
interpretation.pilot: Native single-action rejection and revised JSON pilots have different protocols/public guidance from A1. They were dirty development runs; JSON pilot whole-source hashes changed during execution. No frozen-code or retroactive process/reward gate claim is made. Original native response contains multiple calls and none was executed.
interpretation.price: cost_upper_bound_usd uses the recorded frozen peak rates (input miss0.3/cache-hit0.006/output1.2USD per million tokens), actual reported usage and all failed completions. It is not an invoice. Local Qwen API price0 is not a claim that GPU/energy/time cost is zero.
interpretation.budgets: Adapter decision slots, HTTP attempts, actual returned completions, world tool actions and institutional work outcomes are distinct counts. Conservative input-byte reservation can stop a call before any HTTP attempt; no context cropping, summary rewrite or budget extension was performed.
interpretation.evidence: Large raw requests/responses/token arrays are explicitly referenced and hashed; public world calls retain full arguments and refusal returns, with only large successful returns replaced by hash+actual envelope. Complete historical assessments/rewards and fixed submissions are embedded.
interpretation.limits: Development/interface diagnosis on finite synthetic tasks. Same-scenario stochastic repeats are not independent task sources. No broad model ranking, held-out generalization, or parameter-training gain is inferred.
